question: Should the inherited postpublish verifier share the proposed 120-second hard deadline, or should release owners define a separate deadline for that release-critical local verification path?
rationale: The code makes an intentional release-process availability tradeoff that source inspection and mocked option forwarding cannot resolve; only release ownership can set the acceptable failure budget.

options.title: Use a separate postpublish deadline
options.body: Keep the two-minute bound for network-oriented verifier commands, but split `runCommandInherited` so the postpublish verifier receives a release-owner-approved timeout.

options.title: Approve one shared deadline
options.body: Accept a uniform 120-second deadline for every verifier subprocess after direct proof confirms the desired timeout behavior and failure reporting.
